def parity(x: uint8) -> bool:
    """True when the byte has an odd number of set bits."""
    ex parity(0) == False
    ex parity(1) == True
    ex parity(3) == False
    ex parity(7) == True
    ex parity(255) == False
    ones: uint8 = 0
    n: uint8 = x
    while n > 0:
        ones += n % 2
        n = n // 2
    return ones % 2 == 1
